speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you present with gait and limb ataxia and a significant medical history; to begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these balance and coordination issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; does the clumsiness on your right side affect your ability to perform daily tasks like buttoning a shirt or using utensils? Additionally, have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your limbs, or perhaps slurred speech?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy, likely precipitated by uncontrolled Crohn's disease.
